welcome.js_decs: BELTEI International University will be the most prestigious university in Cambodia with a high quality of education in accordance with national programs and international program standards that are recognized worldwide and in line with BELTEI's motto.
welcome.js_pro_decs: Bilingual lessons in Khmer and English Free 1 year English and computer training
welcome.js__pro_dece2: Free English tutoring, English and computer training for 1 year
welcome.js_decs3: Please respect and welcome His Excellency, Mr. Oknha, Mr. Chumteav, Mr. and Mrs. Bring civil servants, staff, professors, teachers, staff, NGOs and students All who have decided to pursue higher education at BELTEI International University to increase Knowledge, ability and achieve its goals in the future.

computer_intensive.js_com_desc: Computer course is designed to assist students in information technology in order to keep up with the Digital Age. Computer is one of the most important skills for students to study, to research and especially to perform tasks assigned by lecturers. Computer course lasts for 6-month and which carries 12 credits. The students are allowed to choose a study shift that does not overlap with that of Year 1. Upon successfully fulfilling the course requirements, the university will issue a Certificate of Completion for the students.
computer_intensive.js_com_term_1: 1. Candidates of either sex, Cambodian or foreign students, monks, civil servants, company employees and the general public who are pursuing a Bachelor's or Associate Degree in Year 1 in either the National Program or the International Program under any Faculty at BELTEI International University can register to study for free.
computer_intensive.js_com_term_2: 2. Candidates who are NOT pursuing a Bachelor's or Associate Degree in Year 1 under any Faculty at BELTEI International University can also enroll by paying the tuition fee according to the set price list.
computer_intensive.js_com_term_3: 3. Students in Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 who need additional computer training are also eligible to enroll by paying the tuition fee according to the set price list and with the approval of the President and His Excellency Dr., the Chairman.

english_intensive.js_eng_desc: English Intensive Course is designed to fill in the gaps and improve students’ ability to speak, to listen, to write and to read English, and for those who have enrolled in the National Program and have the intension to transfer to study in the International Program in Year 2 or to find a job after successfully completing their Year 1 study. The English Intensive Course is divided into two Courses equivalent to 30 credits, and which requires the students to study for one whole year. The students are allowed to choose a study shift that does not overlap with that of Year 1. Upon successfully fulfilling the course requirements, the university will issue a Certificate of Completion for the students.
english_intensive.js_desc_term_1: 1. Candidates of either sex, Cambodian or foreign students, monks, civil servants, company employees and the general public who are pursuing a Bachelor's or Associate Degree in Year 1in the National Program under any Faculty at BELTEI International University can register to study for free.
english_intensive.js_desc_term_2: 2. Candidates who are NOT pursuing a Bachelor's or Associate Degree in Year 1 in the National Program under any Faculty at BELTEI International University can also enroll by paying the tuition fee according to the set price list.
english_intensive.js_desc_term_3: 3. Students under the International Program or those of Year 2 and Year 3 under the National Program, and whose English proficiency is limited are also eligible to enroll by paying the tuition fee according to the set price list and with the approval of the President and His Excellency Dr., the Chairman.

chinese_intensive.js_chinese_desc: Chinese Intensive Course is designed to improve the competency in Chinese speaking, listening, writing and reading of students who have enrolled in National Program and wish to transfer to International Program in year 2 or want to get a job after completing in year 1 successfully. Chinese Intensive Course is organized into two courses, Intensive Course 1 and Intensive Course 2, which take a full year of study equal to 30 credits. Students can choose any shift to study that does not overlap with the year 1 study and upon successful completion, the university will award the Certificate of Completion.

pedagogy.js_peda_desc: The Pedagogy Training Course is a modern study which helps improving cognitive strategies and teaching strategies of teacher-trainees in this digital era, as well as training in leadership with virtue and proper attitude. It is focused on pedagogical innovation as a direction for the development Human Capitals.
pedagogy.js_term_1: 1. Students who have graduated or have been studying Associate’s Degree, Bachelor’s Degree or above are eligible to register for this Pedagogy Training.
pedagogy.js_term_2: 2. Students may choose either program of the Pedagogy Training (GEd or ESL).
pedagogy.js_term_3: 3. Students from other educational institutions who are studying in Year 1 and above are eligible to register for this Pedagogy Training and will be provided priority to work at BELTEI International schools.
pedagogy.js_program_desc: The curriculum is designed to response 21st century pedagogy which aims to develop the skills and knowledge students need to succeed in working life. All subjects are prepared to offer teacher-trainees with implement innovation learning methods that integrated the use of technologies, inquiry, and problem-based approaches.
pedagogy.js_result_desc: On successful completion of this program, students will be able to:
pedagogy.js_result_1: Administering continuous assessment of instructional process and learning outcomes
pedagogy.js_result_2: Select learning material that suits primary learners’ development
pedagogy.js_result_3: Apply creative approaches, strategies, methods, and teaching techniques for primary level
pedagogy.js_result_4: Make use of ICT to interact with other teacher and for professional development…
pedagogy.js_career_desc: Upon the completion of training, students will become:
pedagogy.js_course_4: 4. Techniques of Teaching Vocabulary and Grammar to ESL Learners
pedagogy.js_course_5: 5. Techniques of Teaching Listening and Speaking to ESL Learner
pedagogy.js_course_6: - Practical Training and Writing a Report (1 Week)
pedagogy.js_course_9: 3. Techniques of Teaching Reading and Writing to ESL Learners
pedagogy.js_course_12: - Practical Training and Writing a Report (1 Week)

dormitory.js_dorm_desc: For the convenience of provincial and international students, BELTEI International  University has constructed a luxurious 7-story dormitory building with 65 rooms, 130 beds, a cafeteria,​ a student lounge and syndicate rooms for student group discussion. Each bedroom contains a bathroom, a kitchen and a study table. We are ready to welcome national and international students for a comfortable stay with an affordable price. This dormitory will start to operate from January 1, 2023.

privacy.js_title: Privacy Policy for BELTEI IU APP
privacy.js_dec: Thank you for choosing the BELTEI IU app . Your privacy is important to us, and we want you to feel confident in how your personal information is handled. This Privacy Policy outlines the information we collect, how we use it, and the measures we take to protect your data.
privacy.js_decs1.1: We collect personal information, including but not limited to your name, email address, phone number, and address when you use specific features of the App. For example, when applying for intensive courses, collaboration opportunities, or job opportunities, we may request additional details to process your application.
privacy.js_decs1.2: We automatically collect information about your usage of the App, such as the pages you visit, the content you interact with, and the duration of your sessions. This data helps us improve the user experience and optimize our services.
privacy.js_decs2.1: Your contact information may be used to send you news and updates about the university, including events, academic achievements, and important announcements.
privacy.js_decs2.2: Personal information is utilized to facilitate the enrollment process for intensive courses and to provide information related to pedagogical approaches adopted by the university.
privacy.js_decs2.3: We use your information to provide details about the main degrees offered by the university and opportunities for collaboration with external entities.
privacy.js_decs2.4: Your personal information may be used to communicate job opportunities relevant to your field of study or professional interests.
privacy.js_decs2.5: Links to the university's social media profiles and website are provided for additional information and engagement. We do not directly access or collect data from your social media accounts.
privacy.js_decs2.6: Information related to students' dormitory preferences may be collected to facilitate accommodation services, ensuring a comfortable living environment.
privacy.js_decs2.7: Your information may be used to provide you with detailed information about the university, its history, mission, and values.
privacy.js_decs3: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your explicit consent, except as necessary for specific services or as required by law.
privacy.js_decs4: We employ industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. This includes encryption, secure data transmission, and access controls.
privacy.js_decs5: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your privacy, please contact us at [biu.admin@neltei.edu.kh]. We are committed to addressing your inquiries promptly.
privacy.js_decs6: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be immediately effective upon posting the updated policy within the App.

sub_program.description1:
BELTEI International High School is the largest private High School, which has the most campuses with the most affordable school fee, and it is leading to the study quality area in providing educational services on Khmer General Education from Grade 7-12 in accordance with the curriculums of the Ministry of Education Youth and Sport's. BELTEI adds more than 5,000 words in English to the titles and the sub-titles from Grade 7-12 and one extra hour of Computer studies per week for Grade 7 (Microsoft Word 2021) and Grade 8 (Microsoft Excel 2021). There are physical education programs by training Taekwondo and Labokathor to our students. Especially, BELTEI has prepared extra classes for Khmer, Mathematics, Physic and Chemistry subjects for Grade 9 every Monday to Friday free of charge.
      Students studying from Grade 7 to Grade 9 will meet the outstanding orators via Extra-curricular Courses and they will have field trips to many historical sites and participate in Public Speaking Contest, Debate Program, Let’s Defense for your Society, Khmer Writing Contest and Mathematics Contest.
      BELTEI' students have passed the exam of Junior High School almost 100%, and have also been the outstanding students in both the exams of the city and country level almost every academic year. Especially, BELTEI will upload the Junior High School diplomas into the website.
sub_program.description2:
BELTEI International High School is the largest private High School, which has the most campuses with the most affordable school fee, and it is leading to the study quality area in providing educational services on Khmer General Education from Grade 7-12 in accordance with the curriculums of the Ministry of Education Youth and Sport's. BELTEI adds more than 5,000 words in English to the titles and the sub-titles from Grade 7-12. Especially, BELTEI has prepared extra classes for Khmer, Mathematics, Physic and Chemistry subjects for Grade 12 every Monday to Friday free of charge.
      Students studying from Grade 10 to Grade 12 will meet the outstanding orators via Extra-curricular Courses and they will have field trips to many historical sites and participate in Public Speaking Contest, Debate Program, Let’s Defense for your Society, Khmer Writing Contest and Mathematics Contest.
      BELTEI' students have passed the national exams of Senior High School throughout the country almost 100%, and have also been the outstanding students in both the exams of the city and country level almost every academic year. Especially, BELTEI will upload the Senior High School diplomas into the website.
sub_program.esl_descript1:
Preschool for General Education grade 1 or ESL Level 1 is the class for children at the age of 5-year-old up students. This Preschool is designed for helping children to be ready in learning General Education Grade 1 or Level 1 ESL easily.
      Studying with other special curricular, which will let children know how to draw the lines (use the rulers), write the cursive letters, color the pictures, and write Khmer, English consonants and vowels correctly with pictures and songs that can help the students to learn and to remember very well and it helps the children to have the basic of speaking, listening, reading and writing the sentences correctly.
sub_program.esl_descript2:
Young learners Level is designed for 6-year-old students up. It is a 3-year course (Level 1 - Level 6). After finishing this course, students will be able to use Intermediate English communication both written and spoken.
      - The curriculum for this course focuses on four skills: Speaking, Reading, Listening and Writing as well as grammar and entertainment with TV programs and folktale stories.
      - Students are studying with foreign teachers one hour per week.
      - For Level 3 to 6 students have Field Trip to the Royal Palace, National Museum, Phnom Penh Safari and other cultural or historical sites once a year.
      - There are English Speaking Contest and English Writing Contest.
      - After graduated from Level 6, students are awarded Local Certificates, which issued by BELTEI Head Quarter and they can continue to study at Level 7 easily.
sub_program.esl_descript3:
It is a 3-year-course (from Level 7-12) for teenagers and adults. The curriculum for this course focuses on four skills: Speaking, Reading, Listening and Writing as well as grammar. When graduating from Level 12, students will get IELTS at least 5.0 and have full of abilities of English on four macro skills to face the challenges in both national and international labor markets successfully.
      - From Level 7 to Level 12, students are studying with foreign teachers one day per week.
      - There are English Speaking Contest English Writing Contest, and BELTEI IS Debate Program.
      - Field Trip to Tamao Mountain, Oudong Moun- tain, Kirirom National Park Preah Sihanouk, Kep Kompot Province and Sombo Prey Kup Temple.
      - It includes TV programs, Conversation, TED Talks, and other speeches.
      - After graduated from Level 12, students are awarded as follow:
      1. BELTEI ESL Diploma which issued by BELTEI Head Quarter.
      2. The International certificates TOEFL issued by ETS from USA or IELTS issued by British Council, from UK and this will be uploaded on BELTEI website.
sub_program.csl_descript1: &nbsp This course is suitable for children or primary school students aged 5-10. It emphasizes the development of Chinese language skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and characters' recognizing. In addition, in view of cultivating the cognitive ability of children or primary school students, the textbooks we choose are all by understanding the world around them through the learning of graphics, colors, directions, songs, games, drawing lines and pictures, coloring, and tracing characters, as well as they may find Chinese language learning more exciting, fun, and can be used flexibly. Our well-designed courses can cultivate children's logical thinking and imaginative skills with the pace for developing language knowledge and skills takes a gradual approach which makes it easy for children to build a solid foundation for learning Chinese. Our courses use 'Easy Steps to Chinese for Kids' which published by Beijing Language and Culture University, 'Chinese Characters Writing' and 'Chinese Eloquence' which was compiled by our BELTEI International School for internal use only.
sub_program.csl_descript2: &nbsp CSL Younger Learners (Level 1-6) aims to help the students from non-Chinese background establish a solid foundation for Chinese learning and to be able to develop their abilities further. This course is suitable for primary and middle school students aged 10-15. By emphasizing the natural and gradual integration of characters, language and culture elements. It is realized from two aspects: the learning of vocabulary and Chinese knowledge and the cultivation of the four skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing as teaching objectives. In view of cultivating students' speaking ability, the textbooks we choose involve the most commonly used vocabulary and sentence patterns in the vocabulary and grammar syllabus, as well as simple communication items in daily life, study, social communication and other communication activities. In addition, in order to encourage primary and middle school students without Chinese background, cultivate and improve their Chinese ability, and obtain ideal results in the International Standardized Chinese Proficiency Test, we have also selected the new standard course of the Young Chinese Test (YCT) as an aid.
sub_program.csl_descript3: &nbsp CSL Teenager or Adult Learners (Level 7-12) is designed to help teenagers or adults from non-Chinese background to comprehensively improve students' listening, speaking, reading and writing, supplement the corresponding applied language and cultural knowledge, highlight the training of paragraphs and discourse lays the foundation for comprehensively consolidating comprehensive Chinese skills. This course is aimed at students who have a Chinese foundation leading to undergraduate studies. It enables students to master 3500-4000 commonly used words and have high language reading skills, especially the ability to understand paragraphs and discourse; through planned Chinese writing training, transition from general paragraphs and discourse training to the writing of narrative, expository, and argumentative essays in the true sense, so that learners can complete general narratives, expository essays, and essays of about 400-600 words and receive a BELTEI CSL Diploma and HSK (Level 5-6) Examination Score Report.
sub_program.itpc_description:
The preparation course is specially designed for the students who wish to seat for the tests to get the certificates with international standards in order to work or win scholarships to study abroad especially, in England, Australia, and America. Students can take the international tests at BELTEI's official test centers which are authorized by 2 main international institutions like:
    1. Authorized IELTS Test Center
    2. ETS Authorized TOEFL iBT Center
    3. GRE Test
    4. Prometric JFT-Basic
    5. Singapore International Math Contests Center
After taking any test from the test centers above, students will receive the international English certificate issued by the 2 institutions above which is located in the United States, and United Kingdom.
sub_program.ima_descript1: Mathematics is a pillar of science and technology. Without mathematics, nothing is possible, it is like walking in the dark. Many great advances are the result of the richness of mathematical science. Develop in innovative technology strategies. In modern society, the development by the mathematical industry plays an important role as a language for analysis, simulation, refinement, calculation and process management.
sub_program.ima_descript2: The curriculum is carefully designed and professional. The curriculum is designed to maintain the quality standards of BELTEI and the quality of the curriculum from Malaysia in order to provide students with real knowledge and skills and to respond to The needs of society and the labor market by focusing on study.
sub_program.ima_descript3:
Upon completion of the IMA program, children are more likely to develop and gain access to:
      · Increase Spatial Memory
      · Visual perception
      · Increase visual memory
      · Provide and train children to apply their Imagination power
      · Develop the right brain
      · Improve reasoning, judgment and application power
      · Improve the ability of calculation
      · Improve rapid and accurate living habits
      · Highly creative
      · Children can become good students, think and solve math problems well, accurately, quickly and proficiently.
 · Children can become math students in class school and country.
      · Children will be able to enter math competitions on the national and international stage.

condition.js_title: Terms and Conditions for BELTEI IS APP
condition.js_dec: Welcome to BELTEI IS App of BELTEI International School. The BELTEI IS App is a digital E-Learning program, including General Education (designed and conducted in accordance with the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MoEYS) curriculum and syllabus from grades 1 to 12 and provides useful lessons for the secondary school and High school national examination), English as a Second Language (Preschool 1 to Level 12), Intelligent Mental-Arithmetic, Computer Training Course, International Test Preparation Course, and other academic programs. All learners can use the BELTEI IS App to review lessons or help fill their imperfections during class and learn new skills.Please read carefully the terms and conditions before registering the BELTEI IS App.
condition.js_title1: 1. Agreement on the Terms of Use
condition.js_title1.1: Accounts for the BELTEI IS App are issued exclusively by the school. Upon completion of payment at the school, new students will be provided with a ID Card and Password by the school reception. These accounts grant students access to E-Learning resources, including video lessons, homework assignments, and information regarding upcoming payments ect.Parents or guardians will also receive individual accounts, enabling them to monitor their child’s academic progress and manage payments. Student accounts are restricted and do not permit direct payments through the app.
condition.js_title2.1: The BELTEI IS App will be constantly updated on the terms of use, and other features based on the realities, and the BELTEI IS App will send a notification to all users on their mobile phones or tablets in advance. It will be valid immediately when the settings are updated. If you continue to use the App, you have agreed to and accepted this update.
condition.js_title3.1: The BELTEI IS App can only use with Android or IOS devices, the computer is not available. Therefore, it’s requiring you to have a capable mobile phone or tablet to download from Play Store (Android) or App Store (IOS) and must be connected to the internet to run all the icons, especially the E-Learning Program.The internet expense is your responsibility and the videos may be slow depending on the speed of your internet access.
condition.js_title4.1: You can register and create the BELTEI IS App account by entering your full name, current phone number, and password.When you have already had an account, please complete your background attach a photo to the App to confirm your identity.
condition.js_title5.1: Please take responsibility for account security yourself. Your account can only access on one device. If you want to use your account to log in to another device, you have to log out of your account from the current device and sign up for the new one.
condition.js_title6.4: Your payment can be made online (Online Payment) through ABA Mobile or Credit Card/ Debit Card/ Visa Card/ MasterCard.BELTEI IS App will not keep any information about your bank card when you make payment transactions.
condition.js_title7.1: The User's obligation is to obey the terms of use of the BELTEI IS App. The BELTEI IS App has the right to terminate the user by suspending any account in the event of a serious violation of these terms of use. The user’s promising and ensuring to the following prohibitions:
condition.js_title7.2: - Do not enter fake information for the purpose to deceive others.
condition.js_title7.3: - Do not take any action that will affect the public and the country’s reputation.
condition.js_title7.4: - Do not use databases, copy documents, lessons, photos, and videos to teach at other places or for commercial use without written permission from the BELTEI IS App and the BELTEI International School.
condition.js_title7.5: - Do not attack (Hack), download data, copy software code that makes the program get stuck.
condition.js_title8.1: Your personal information will keep in privacy for the specific purpose of providing useful information. We will not show your identity to a third party without your permission.
condition.js_title9.1: Video lessons and teaching materials are produced by BELTEI International School which exist in the BELTEI IS App is belonged to BELTEI International School, not allowed to copy. In case, if we found any copy without permission from the BELTEI IS App and BELTEI International School, you will be faced with the law.
condition.js_title10.1: Any questions related to the technical issue, terms of use as well as other information, please feel free to contact us through Email: belteiisapp@beltei.edu.kh.
